parameters.name: BranchId
parameters.description: The branch ID that uniquely identifies a Supabase branch.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client idempotency token that ensures the idempotence of retry requests.

parameters.name: PreserveUnderName
parameters.description: The backup branch name. If specified, automatic creation of a backup branch is performed before recovery.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The Supabase project ID associated with the primary branch.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. This parameter is required when you create a primary branch. When you create a sub-branch, the region is inherited from the primary branch by default.

parameters.name: SourceBranchId
parameters.description: The ID of the source branch from which to recover.

parameters.name: SourceBranchLsn
parameters.description: The LSN of the source branch to recover to.

parameters.name: SourceBranchTimestamp
parameters.description: The point in time of the source branch to recover to. The value must be within the recoverable time window.
